cognium_conformis.latest_main_difference: This is `main` as fetched on 2026-11-02, 733 commits after the 2026-10-13 run's revision `28f9e14d`.

rerun.title: Accessibility benchmark: Cognium Conformis at main on the latest browser-served lane
rerun.purpose: This bundle runs Cognium Conformis at `main` (`7fa92329`) on the same 214 pages, corpus revision, subject declaration, host, browser build and fonts as `2026-11-02-rerun-v0.1.0-latest-browser-served`, which re-ran the 2026-10-13 revision `28f9e14d`. With everything else held fixed, the comparison below isolates the product revision. No other product was run.
rerun.comparison_note: Every corrected control stayed target-clean. Criterion credit follows the pack's own control-to-criterion mapping: for example `AX-15/1.4.11-forced` deviates under both 1.4.11 and 1.3.1, which is how `journey-consent-broken` and `surface-chatbot_transcript` gain 1.3.1.

difference_notes.cognium: Thirteen known-defect cases gain a declared criterion and none loses one. Twelve cells move from `o` to `.`, eleven media pages and `keyboard-safe_native_date_fields`: at `28f9e14d` the only finding on each was the keyboard-trap control `AX-08/2.1.2` under 2.1.2, which none of them declares, and at `main` that control reports nothing there. Five cells move from `.` to `o`: `scenario-dragging_required` (`AX-10/2.1.1` under 2.1.1) and four flash pages (`AX-41/1.3.3` under 1.3.3), criteria those pages do not declare.

reference_scorer.note: The reference scorer of the pinned corpus revision (`check/score.mjs` at `469486a4`, policy `cognium-a11y-scoring/1.0.0`, `--strict`) applied to this bundle's `result.json`. For `28f9e14d` on the same host it gives 71/207 (34.3%), 71/189 (37.6%) and 0/192.

environment_differences: None in host, operating system, Node.js, browser build or fonts: this scan used the same host as the re-run bundle, Chromium 153.0.8010.12 and the host fonts.
This scan ran alone; the re-run's Conformis scan ran alongside the direct tools.

Conformis at `main` uses browser driver 0.26.1 and static-html driver 0.3.0 (0.9.13 and 0.2.3 at `28f9e14d`). Both revisions pin the same container image digest and ran through the same local stand-in for `docker`.
limits: One repetition per revision. The difference between the two Conformis revisions is two single runs.
`a11y/html@1.6.1` and `tech/html-aria@1.3.0` are workspace versions at `7fa92329`, not published registry versions; the commit is the pin. The repository is private.
This bundle keeps the 2026-10-13 corpus revision. Later corpus revisions changed some assertions, and results against them are not comparable with this one.
No flows or state drivers were declared: the lane measures loaded entry pages.
